Development Timeline

Phased development plan for the Circular Enterprises platform across Hudson Valley.

Jan 2025

Phase I — Predevelopment Begins

Restaurant concept, design & entitlement. Land acquisitions underway for Resort and Residences parcels.

Jun 2026

Phase I Financing Closing

LP equity and senior construction debt for Wren of the Woods close. Permits in hand; site mobilization begins.

Jul 2026

Restaurant Site Prep & Foundation

Groundbreaking, excavation, foundation pour on the restaurant parcel.

Sep 2026

Restaurant Framing & Envelope

Structural framing, roof, and weather-tight envelope complete.

Nov 2026

Restaurant MEP & Interior Fit-Out

Mechanical, electrical, plumbing rough-in; kitchen build-out; interior finishes.

May 2027

Restaurant FF&E Install

Kitchen equipment, dining FF&E, and technology commissioning.

Jul 2027

Restaurant CofO

Wren of the Woods construction completes. Phase I capital: $10.4M ($4.69M equity).

Sep 2027

Restaurant Grand Opening

Wren of the Woods opens to the public (90 seats). Stabilized prime cost target ~65.8%.

Dec 2026 – Feb 2027

Phase II — Resort Construction Begins

Livingston Farm resort (70 keys) construction commences. USDA B&I and C-PACE financing closes. Phase II capital: $70.7M ($25.1M equity).

2027

Farm Operations Begin

Agroforestry, animal husbandry and agritourism programming begin on-site.

Jun 2028

Resort Grand Opening

Livingston Farm resort opens with Year 1 occupancy ~44.8%, ADR $748, RevPAR $335. Year 1 revenue ~$11.9M.

Aug – Oct 2027

Phase III — Residences Land & Launch

Land acquisition Mar–Apr 2026; presales launch 2028. 20 villas + 10 townhomes. Phase III capital: $32.2M ($9.17M equity).

2029

Farm Break-Even

Farm operations reach break-even with $211K revenue and $152K OpEx. Net income turns positive at $58K.

2029–2030

Resort Ramp-Up

Occupancy grows toward 64.8% stabilized. Blended ADR stabilizes at $807. Total revenue reaches $22.0M at stabilization.

Sep 2030

Residences Delivery Complete

All 30 units delivered. Gross sales $51.0M, all-in cost $37.0M, 22.5% build margin.

2031

Platform Stabilization

Resort at 64.8% occupancy, $904 ADR, $586 RevPAR. NOI $7.5M (~$107K/key, 37% margin).

2035–2039

Stabilized Operations & Exit

Continued 3% ADR growth. Platform levered IRR 28.1%, unlevered 15.4%, drawn EM 3.28x. Exit or refinance evaluation.
